_note: Expected outcome of each example against the proposed 0.1.0-draft schemas. Valid files must pass their schema; invalid files must fail it.

result-authorized-field.json.reason: no authorization field exists; unknown fields are rejected

result-failed-without-errors.json.reason: FAILED needs at least one error

result-score-without-scale.json.reason: a score needs scale, source and calibration

result-completed-without-output.json.reason: COMPLETED needs the full execution record, including output

result-partial-attempt-only-provenance.j.reason: PARTIAL needs the full execution record

context-stale-observation-marked-usable..reason: a STALE, MISSING or INVALID observation must have usable false

context-observation-no-clock.json.reason: an observation reference carries its clock

request-freshness-now-without-clock.json.reason: now_ns needs the clock it came from

result-sense-error-code-as-mind-code.jso.reason: a Sense code is not a Mind code; it goes in detail.sense_error_code

result-skill-id-uppercase.json.reason: skill_id must be a lowercase dotted name

result-version-constraint-latest.json.reason: version_constraint must follow the closed grammar; no tags

result-input-without-digest.json.reason: the execution record input needs a digest

result-output-without-digest.json.reason: the execution record output needs a digest

result-context-snapshot-without-digest.j.reason: a context snapshot needs a digest

result-completed-without-context-snapsho.reason: COMPLETED needs a context snapshot for replay

result-failed-with-only-warning.json.reason: FAILED needs at least one error of severity ERROR

result-placement-unknown-value.json.reason: placement is EDGE, NEXUS or CLOUD

context-valid-observation-with-sense-err.reason: a VALID observation must not carry sense_error_code (Sense forbids error_code when VALID)

context-sense-error-code-lowercase.json.reason: sense_error_code is an upper-case Sense code

result-proposal-id-slash.json.reason: proposal_id uses the same identifier character set
